messages:
Priya S: Proposal: emit provisional "snapshot" invoice lines when we detect an ingest gap for a tenant >10m. Mark them as provisional so customers see expected charge but we can reconcile when final events land.

Maya R: How is snapshot different from hedging?

Priya S: Hedging was a claim-level concept. Snapshot is a preview-first approach: we create a provisional snapshot_id that references the last-known request keys and estimated token count. Keeps preview UX consistent.

Kevin L: Need fields: snapshot_id, provisional=true, snapshot_provenance, snapshot_ttl_seconds, estimate_source (edge|proxy|fallback). Also store fingerprint list for matching final events.

Anu P: Reconcile behavior: support actions [commit, adjust, void]. Commit replaces provisional with final line item. Adjust applies delta. Void removes provisional and emits audit event.

Alex H: Ops: feature flag billing.provisional_snapshots.v1, tenant opt-in. Canary steps: 5 -> 50 -> 250 tenants. UI should show a small "provisional" pill on invoice lines and a roll-forward tooltip.

Priya S: Console UX mock: add a toggle "Show provisional snapshots" and a top-banner when present: "Some invoice lines are provisional; final values may change after reconciliation." Add per-tenant histogram of provisional ratio.

Kevin L: Metrics: billing.snapshot_emitted_total, billing.snapshot_committed_total, billing.snapshot_adjusted_total, billing.snapshot_voided_total, billing.snapshot_reconcile_latency_seconds p50/p95. Alert if reconcile_delta_percent > 2% for >1h.

Maya R: Contract changes for producers: include client_request_id or X-Snapshot-Provenance header. If absent, fallback fingerprint = sha256(tenant|route|approx_ts). But warn: fallbacks increase false positives.

Anu P: API examples:
GET /api/v1/invoices/preview?tenant=acme&include=provisional
Response: [{"snapshot_id":"s_20260311_01","provisional":true,"estimate_cents":4500,"provenance":"x-abc","created_at":"2026-03-11T09:12:00Z"}]

POST /billing/snapshot/reconcile
{ "snapshot_id": "s_20260311_01", "action": "adjust", "final_cents": 4300 }

Kevin L: Who owns autosettle policy? If no final arrives, propose: after 14 days mark snapshot -> stale and move to audit queue. Not auto-void to avoid undercharge. Manual billing ops review required.

Alex H: Ops UX: console should expose a "force commit" for SRE/SE roles with justification field that writes to audit log. Also a flag to hide provisional amounts from external invoice exports until committed.

Priya S: SDK change: add helper to populate X-Snapshot-Provenance and expose an idempotency helper for client libs. Add integration test: simulate split-final events to ensure adjust works.

Maya R: Also need ledger PATCH semantics and idempotent reconcile endpoints. Reconcile webhook to customers optional: POST /hooks/billing/reconcile with delta and snapshot_id.

Kevin L: Dashboard: show time-series of provisional percent by tenant, plus top-20 tenants by snapshot volume. Add an incident playbook step: if reconcile_failure_rate > 10% for 30m, pager.

billing-bot: deploy-bot: billing-service v2.15.0 deployed to staging; flag billing.provisional_snapshots.v1=false.

Priya S: I'll write the design doc draft and link PRs for schema, API, console and SDK changes. PTAL @Maya R @Kevin L @Anu P.
